source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this model has to join 1 **COMMAND SQUAD** unit of your army; each **COMMAND SQUAD** can take at most 1 **LOYAL PROTECTOR** model. From then until the battle ends, it is part of that unit, whose **Starting Strength** rises to match. If it cannot join one, it is left out of the battle and is treated as **destroyed**.

While attached to a unit, it may embark in any **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/transports)** its unit may embark in, filling 3 model spaces. It can never be your **WARLORD**.

detail.trigger: start of Declare Battle Formations step
